name: core
description: Guardrails for git, shell and secret files, a session brief and git context that survives compaction. The base every working-bee plugin depends on.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branches Claude must not commit or push to directly. A project's .claude/working-bee.json overrides this.

brief_open_prs.title: List open PRs in the session brief
brief_open_prs.description: Calls `gh pr list` when a session starts. Turn off if gh is not installed or the network is slow.
